scope: Same-source isolated base/features A/B, fresh browser per case, c3 actual autoplay zero to .5. rAF window .15-.5; native cumulative renderCount is a separate CPU submission-path counter with nominal100ms DOM refresh. No clock acceleration, screenshots during measurement, private React hooks, image downgrade or source program changes. CPU profiling1000us has overhead and is applied equally. OS/GPU driver caches are not reset; ABBA order only partly controls visit/cache bias.

environment.gpu: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (0x00002C05) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

cpu.scope: Complete real autoplay zero-.5; not only the .15-.5 rAF window.

entryGates.limit: Page performance.now observer timestamps; first-frame DOM diagnostic can lag its CPU submission by the nominal100ms update cadence. No hidden-page time in this run.

measurement.nativeCounterLimit: Cumulative completed CPU submission path; two nominal100ms diagnostic boundaries. Not individual frame intervals, GPU completion or display presentation.
